member.name: T:Microsoft.Xbox.MethodExtensions
member.summary: Provides extension methods for that query and set which Xbox 360 hardware thread a managed thread runs on.
member.remarks: Both methods operate only on the calling thread; passing any other thread throws .

member.name: M:Microsoft.Xbox.MethodExtensions.GetCurrentProcessorNumber(System.Threading.Thread)
member.summary: Returns the number of the hardware thread the calling thread is currently running on.
member.param: The thread to query. Must be the current thread.

member.name: M:Microsoft.Xbox.MethodExtensions.SetProcessorAffinity(System.Threading.Thread,System.Int32[])
member.summary: Moves the calling thread to the specified hardware thread.
member.param: The thread to move. Must be the current thread.
Exactly one hardware thread number, from 0 to 5.
member.remarks: Throws if is null, and if it does not contain exactly one value in the range 0 to 5, if is not the current thread, or if the affinity cannot be set.

member.name: M:System.Security.Cryptography.AesManaged.Dispose(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Releases the resources used by the object.
member.param: true to release both managed and unmanaged resources; false to release only unmanaged resources.
